status: The Modwerk core implementing this interface is in development. Mods written for this interface link with it unchanged.

events.name: ev_tick
events.handler: void f(ctrl); set ctrl+0x20 to recompose

events.name: ev_draw
events.when: after the OS draws the screen

events.name: ev_key
events.handler: int f(brain, KeyEvent*); nonzero takes it

events.name: ev_enc
events.handler: int f(brain, EncoderEvent*); nonzero takes it

events.name: ev_pattern_change
events.when: the OS is about to load a new pattern's kit; runs in the UI task before the kit is applied
events.handler: int f(int new_pat, int old_pat); return the kit-source pattern (0..127); default is new_pat. Handlers run from lowest to highest order; each receives the previous handler's return value as new_pat, so the final result is the last nonzero return or new_pat unchanged.
events.order: 50 is mid-range; mods that redirect kit loading sit here
events.status: PROPOSED — site addresses not yet found; fill in event-probe.json once located in the stock OS binary. The kit-per-bank module depends on this hook and is held until it ships.

tables.name: core_machines
tables.purpose: Pointers to six-long descriptors for SRC machine ids 4–127; the OS lists, names, sets, loads and renders them as the stock machine they stand in for.

exports.name: core_additem
exports.purpose: Add a SETTINGS row from an ev_settings handler.

exports.name: core_track_machine
exports.purpose: Each track's own machine id as the render last took it.

exports.name: core_machine
exports.purpose: The added machine descriptor for an id, or zero.

exports.name: core_zero
exports.purpose: What a weak import resolves to when no mod provides it.
